evidence.detail: Current legality section uses {{> legal}} partial with legal_icons (season icons); no popularity-over-time chart exists for cards
Card view computes legal_seasons but has no history_chart or per-season usage stats
Archetype view already has history_chart() with meta_share per season — analogous feature exists for archetypes but not cards

triage.notes: The issue author explicitly says 'Not sure' about the key design question: whether to use logarithmic, percentile, or per-card-relative Y-axis scaling. That unresolved product decision must be answered before implementation begins.
